scientific_integrity: Normalization and generic normal-crossings are known from Choudary (1990) and credited. Conductor ideal and Euler-polynomial assertions are derived here, with explicit residual historical originality risk. Finite checks are not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Complex coefficients and degrees at least two; no minimal presentation of the Jacobian or reduced subresultant ideals and no classification of higher-gcd formal germs. Self-review only, not independently audited. The Choudary 1990 source predates the day-resolved arXiv sources but has only February 1990 public-date evidence; no exact public day is invented.
title: Reduced conductor and normalization-defect Euler polynomial of binary resultant hypersurfaces
